pages.text: The Infusion Altar is a crafting structure that is $(bold)usually$() used to create Mystical Agriculture seeds. The structure consists of 1 Infusion Altar and 8 Infusion Pedestals. $(br2)Once you have a recipe put in place, you just need to activate the altar with a Wand or Redstone signal.

Placing the Infusion Altar in world will show you where to place your pedestals. $(br2)$(l:https://blakesmods.com/wiki/mysticalagriculture/guides/creating-seeds)Click here for a detailed guide on using the Infusion Altar.$()
